data.name: A11y_UA7_1
data.value: The document has no structure tree: it isn't tagged.

data.value: The document doesn't say it is tagged (MarkInfo with Marked true).

data.name: A11y_UA6_1
data.value: The file doesn't start with a PDF 1.x header.

data.name: A11y_UA6_1_Fix
data.value: Save it again as a PDF 1.7 file (PDF/UA-1 is based on PDF 1.7).

data.name: A11y_UA7_1_P
data.value: A tag has no link to its parent tag (its P entry is missing).

data.name: A11y_UA7_1_P_Fix
data.value: Re-tag the document, or rebuild its tags in a tag editor.

data.name: A11y_UA7_2_Lang
data.value: A language is written in a form that isn't a language code (such as en-US).

data.name: A11y_UA7_2_Lang_Fix
data.value: Set the language to a code such as en, en-US or es (in a PDF editor's document properties, or the tag's language in a tag editor).

data.name: A11y_01_001
data.value: Decorative content is tagged as real content.

data.name: A11y_01_001_How
data.value: Check that page numbers, running headers and background art are artifacts.

data.name: A11y_01_002
data.value: Real content is marked as an artifact.

data.name: A11y_01_002_How
data.value: Check that nothing a reader needs is hidden from screen readers as an artifact.

data.name: A11y_01_003
data.value: Content marked as an artifact is inside tagged content.

data.name: A11y_01_004
data.value: Tagged content is inside content marked as an artifact.

data.name: A11y_01_005
data.value: Content is neither tagged nor marked as an artifact.

data.name: A11y_01_006
data.value: A tag's type or attributes don't fit its content.

data.name: A11y_01_007
data.value: The document says its tags may be wrong (Suspects is true).

data.name: A11y_01_007_Fix
data.value: Check and fix the tags, then clear Suspects (re-saving from a tag editor does it).

data.name: A11y_02_001
data.value: A custom tag type doesn't map to a standard type.

data.name: A11y_02_001_Fix
data.value: Map each custom tag type to the standard type that fits it (the role map), in the program that made the PDF or a tag editor.

data.name: A11y_02_002
data.value: A custom tag type maps to a standard type that doesn't fit it.

data.name: A11y_02_003
data.value: The role map goes round in a circle.

data.name: A11y_02_003_Fix
data.value: Fix the role map so every custom type ends at a standard type.

data.name: A11y_02_004
data.value: A standard tag type is mapped to another type.

data.name: A11y_02_004_Fix
data.value: Remove standard types (P, H1, Figure…) from the role map.

data.name: A11y_03_001
data.value: An action makes something flicker.

data.name: A11y_03_002
data.value: A video or animation flickers.

data.name: A11y_03_003
data.value: A script makes something flicker.

data.name: A11y_04_001
data.value: Meaning is carried by color, contrast, format or layout alone.

data.name: A11y_05_001
data.value: A video's sound isn't available in another form.

data.name: A11y_05_002
data.value: A sound isn't available in another form.

data.name: A11y_05_003
data.value: A script beeps without another way of telling.

data.name: A11y_06_001
data.value: The document has no XMP metadata.

data.name: A11y_06_001_Fix
data.value: Give it a title in File › Document Properties and save: Inkvolt PDF writes XMP metadata when it saves.

data.name: A11y_06_002
data.value: The metadata doesn't say the file is PDF/UA (pdfuaid:part 1).

data.name: A11y_06_002_Fix
data.value: Save it as PDF/UA from the program that made it (Word: PDF options › “PDF/UA compliant”), or add the PDF/UA identifier in a tag editor.

data.name: A11y_06_003
data.value: The metadata has no title (dc:title).

data.name: A11y_06_003_Fix
data.value: Give the document a title: File › Document Properties › Title in Inkvolt PDF, then save.

data.name: A11y_06_004
data.value: The title doesn't say what the document is.

data.name: A11y_07_001
data.value: The document doesn't ask viewers to show its title (DisplayDocTitle is missing).

data.name: A11y_07_001_Fix
data.value: Turn on “Show document title” in a PDF editor's document properties (Initial View), or save the PDF again from Word with document properties included.

data.name: A11y_07_002
data.value: The document asks viewers to show its file name instead of its title (DisplayDocTitle is false).

data.name: A11y_08_001
data.value: Recognized (OCR) text has many mistakes.

data.name: A11y_08_002
data.value: Recognized (OCR) text isn't tagged.

data.name: A11y_09_001
data.value: The tags aren't in a sensible reading order.

data.name: A11y_09_002
data.value: Tags are nested in a way that makes no sense (a table inside a heading).

data.name: A11y_09_003
data.value: A tag's type doesn't fit its content.

data.name: A11y_09_004
data.value: A table's tags are put together wrongly (rows, cells, header and body groups).

data.name: A11y_09_004_Fix
data.value: Rebuild the table's tags: Table › TR (or THead/TBody/TFoot › TR) › TH or TD, every row with the same number of cells.

data.name: A11y_09_005
data.value: A list's tags are put together wrongly.

data.name: A11y_09_005_Fix
data.value: Rebuild the list's tags: L › LI › Lbl and LBody.

data.name: A11y_09_006
data.value: A table of contents' tags are put together wrongly.

data.name: A11y_09_006_Fix
data.value: Rebuild the contents' tags: TOC › TOCI (an optional Caption first).

data.name: A11y_09_007
data.value: A Ruby tag is put together wrongly.

data.name: A11y_09_007_Note
data.value: Not checked yet (Ruby is rare; veraPDF doesn't check it either).

data.name: A11y_09_008
data.value: A Warichu tag is put together wrongly.

data.name: A11y_09_008_Note
data.value: Not checked yet (Warichu is rare; veraPDF doesn't check it either).

data.name: A11y_10_001
data.value: A character can't be turned into text (it has no Unicode value).

data.name: A11y_10_001_Note
data.value: Checked as 31-027, font by font (each character a font draws must have a Unicode value).

data.name: A11y_11_001
data.value: The language of text on the page can't be told.

data.name: A11y_11_002
data.value: The language of alternate, actual or expansion text can't be told.

data.name: A11y_11_003
data.value: The language of the bookmarks can't be told.

data.name: A11y_11_004
data.value: The language of a comment's or link's text can't be told.

data.name: A11y_11_005
data.value: The language of a form field's description can't be told.

data.name: A11y_11_006
data.value: The language of the metadata (title, description) can't be told.

data.name: A11y_11_007
data.value: The declared language is wrong.

data.name: A11y_12_001
data.value: Stretched characters aren't shown properly.

data.name: A11y_13_001
data.value: A picture or drawing that means something isn't tagged as a Figure.

data.name: A11y_13_002
data.value: A Figure holds things that don't belong together.

data.name: A11y_13_003
data.value: A caption isn't tagged as a Caption.

data.name: A11y_13_004
data.value: A figure has no alternate text.

data.name: A11y_13_004_Fix
data.value: Give the figure alternate text that says what it shows (Word: right-click › Edit Alt Text, before making the PDF), or mark it as an artifact if it is decoration.

data.name: A11y_13_005
data.value: A figure uses actual text where alternate text fits better.

data.name: A11y_13_006
data.value: A drawing that only means something with others is tagged on its own.

data.name: A11y_13_007
data.value: A more accessible form isn't used.

data.name: A11y_13_008
data.value: A figure meant to be read as text has no actual text.

data.name: A11y_14_001
data.value: Headings aren't tagged as headings.

data.name: A11y_14_002
data.value: The first numbered heading isn't H1.

data.name: A11y_14_002_Fix
data.value: Start with an H1 heading (Word: use the Heading 1 style for the first heading).

data.name: A11y_14_003
data.value: A heading level is skipped (an H3 right after an H1).

data.name: A11y_14_003_Fix
data.value: Use heading levels in order without gaps (Word: Heading 1, then Heading 2, …).

data.name: A11y_14_004
data.value: Numbered headings don't use Arabic numerals.

data.name: A11y_14_005
data.value: A 7th-level heading doesn't use H7.

data.name: A11y_14_006
data.value: A tag holds more than one H heading.

data.name: A11y_14_006_Fix
data.value: Use numbered headings (H1-H6), or give each H heading its own section.

data.name: A11y_14_007
data.value: The document uses both H and H1-H6 headings.

data.name: A11y_14_007_Fix
data.value: Use one kind of heading: numbered headings (H1-H6) throughout.

data.name: A11y_15_001
data.value: A row's header cell isn't tagged as a header.

data.name: A11y_15_002
data.value: A column's header cell isn't tagged as a header.

data.name: A11y_15_003
data.value: A header cell (TH) has no scope, and the table doesn't link cells to headers.

data.name: A11y_15_003_Fix
data.value: Give each header cell a scope (Row, Column or Both) in a tag editor, or link data cells to their headers (Headers and IDs).

data.name: A11y_15_004
data.value: Something that isn't a table is tagged as one.

data.name: A11y_15_005
data.value: A cell's header can't be told for sure.

data.name: A11y_16_001
data.value: An ordered list has no numbering attribute.

data.name: A11y_16_002
data.value: An ordered list's numbering attribute isn't a known kind.

data.name: A11y_16_003
data.value: A list isn't tagged as a list.

data.name: A11y_17_001
data.value: A formula isn't tagged as a Formula.

data.name: A11y_17_002
data.value: A formula has no alternate text.

data.name: A11y_17_002_Fix
data.value: Give the formula alternate text that reads it out (in a tag editor, or with a LaTeX package that writes it).

data.name: A11y_17_003
data.value: A formula's characters can't be turned into text.

data.name: A11y_17_003_Note
data.value: Checked as 10-001 for every character, formulas included.

data.name: A11y_18_001
data.value: Running headers and footers aren't marked as pagination artifacts.

data.name: A11y_18_002
data.value: Running header or footer artifacts aren't marked as Header or Footer.

data.name: A11y_19_001
data.value: Footnotes or endnotes aren't tagged as Note.

data.name: A11y_19_002
data.value: References aren't tagged as Reference.

data.name: A11y_19_003
data.value: A note has no ID.

data.name: A11y_19_003_Fix
data.value: Give each Note tag an ID (re-tag, or add it in a tag editor).

data.name: A11y_19_004
data.value: Two notes have the same ID.

data.name: A11y_19_004_Fix
data.value: Give each Note tag its own ID.

data.name: A11y_20_001
data.value: A layer configuration in Configs has no name.

data.name: A11y_20_001_Fix
data.value: Name every layer configuration (in the program that made the layers).

data.name: A11y_20_002
data.value: The default layer configuration has no name.

data.name: A11y_20_002_Fix
data.value: Name the default layer configuration (in the program that made the layers).

data.name: A11y_20_003
data.value: A layer configuration has an AS entry (layers switched automatically).

data.name: A11y_20_003_Fix
data.value: Remove the automatic layer states (AS) from the layer configurations.

data.name: A11y_21_001
data.value: An attached file's description lacks its file names (F and UF).

data.name: A11y_21_001_Fix
data.value: Attach the file again (Review › Attach a File… writes both names).

data.name: A11y_22_001
data.value: Article threads don't follow the reading order.

data.name: A11y_23_001
data.value: Digital signatures: no test of their own (their form fields are checked).

data.name: A11y_24_001
data.value: A non-interactive form isn't tagged with PrintField attributes.

data.name: A11y_25_001
data.value: The file holds a dynamic XFA form (dynamicRender required).

data.name: A11y_25_001_Fix
data.value: Save the form as a static (AcroForm) PDF form.

data.name: A11y_26_001
data.value: The file is encrypted without saying what readers may do (no P entry).

data.name: A11y_26_001_Fix
data.value: Remove the protection, or protect it again (File › Protect with Password…) with copying for accessibility allowed.

data.name: A11y_26_002
data.value: The file's protection stops screen readers from reading it.

data.name: A11y_26_002_Fix
data.value: Protect it again allowing copying for accessibility, or remove the protection (File › Remove Protection…).

data.name: A11y_27_001
data.value: Navigation: no test of its own (use the right tags).

data.name: A11y_28_001
data.value: A comment or link isn't in the reading order.

data.name: A11y_28_002
data.value: A comment isn't inside an Annot tag.

data.name: A11y_28_002_Fix
data.value: Tag each comment with an Annot tag, or flatten the comments that are only marks (File › Flatten…), then tag the page.

data.name: A11y_28_003
data.value: A comment is used for looks but isn't tagged for what it means.

data.name: A11y_28_004
data.value: A comment or link has no description (no Contents, no alternate text).

data.name: A11y_28_004_Fix
data.value: Give the comment text, or the link a description (in a tag editor, its Contents or alternate text).

data.name: A11y_28_005
data.value: A form field has no description (no tooltip, no alternate text).

data.name: A11y_28_005_Fix
data.value: Give each form field a tooltip (in Inkvolt PDF: Forms › field properties › Tooltip); screen readers read it as the field's name.

data.name: A11y_28_006
data.value: An annotation of a type ISO 32000 doesn't define doesn't follow the rules for annotations.

data.name: A11y_28_006_Note
data.value: Checked as 28-002 and 28-004, which every annotation must meet.

data.name: A11y_28_007
data.value: The file holds a trap network annotation (TrapNet).

data.name: A11y_28_007_Fix
data.value: Remove the trap network (it is for printing presses, not readers).

data.name: A11y_28_008
data.value: A page with annotations doesn't set its tab order (Tabs is missing).

data.name: A11y_28_008_Fix
data.value: Set the page's tab order to follow the tags (Tabs = S): re-save from a program that does, or set it in an editor's page properties.

data.name: A11y_28_009
data.value: A page with annotations sets a tab order that doesn't follow the tags (Tabs isn't S).

data.name: A11y_28_009_Fix
data.value: Set the page's tab order to follow the tags (Tabs = S).

data.name: A11y_28_010
data.value: A form field isn't inside a Form tag.

data.name: A11y_28_010_Fix
data.value: Tag each form field with a Form tag (in a tag editor, or re-tag the form).

data.name: A11y_28_011
data.value: A link isn't inside a Link tag.

data.name: A11y_28_011_Fix
data.value: Tag each link with a Link tag holding the link and its text.

data.name: A11y_28_012
data.value: A link has no description (Contents).

data.name: A11y_28_012_Fix
data.value: Give each link a description of where it goes (its Contents).

data.name: A11y_28_013
data.value: An image map's links aren't available another way.

data.name: A11y_28_014
data.value: A video or sound clip doesn't say its type (CT).

data.name: A11y_28_014_Fix
data.value: Embed the media again from a program that writes its type.

data.name: A11y_28_015
data.value: A video or sound clip has no alternate description (Alt).

data.name: A11y_28_015_Fix
data.value: Give the media clip an alternate description.

data.name: A11y_28_016
data.value: An attached-file comment's file lacks its file names (F and UF).

data.name: A11y_28_016_Fix
data.value: Attach the file again.

data.name: A11y_28_017
data.value: A printer's mark is in the tags.

data.name: A11y_28_017_Fix
data.value: Take printer's marks out of the tags (they are artifacts).

data.name: A11y_28_018
data.value: A printer's mark's appearance isn't marked as an artifact.

data.name: A11y_28_018_Note
data.value: Not checked yet (printer's marks are for printing presses; rare in documents for reading).

data.name: A11y_29_001
data.value: A script needs keys pressed with a particular timing.

data.name: A11y_30_001
data.value: The file holds a reference XObject (content taken from another file).

data.name: A11y_30_001_Fix
data.value: Make the PDF again with the referenced content included.

data.name: A11y_30_002
data.value: A form XObject with tagged content is drawn more than once.

data.name: A11y_30_002_Fix
data.value: Make the PDF again so repeated content is either an artifact or tagged each time it appears.

data.name: A11y_31_008

data.value: A glyph's width in the PDF differs from its width in the font.

data.name: A11y_CheckTitle
data.value: Does the title say what the document is?

data.name: A11y_CheckTitleHow
data.value: File › Document Properties › Title. A file name or “Document1” isn't a title.

data.name: A11y_CheckReadingOrder
data.value: Is the reading order sensible?

data.name: A11y_CheckReadingOrderHow
data.value: Turn on Read Aloud (Ctrl+Shift+Y) or a screen reader and listen to a few pages: columns, sidebars, captions and footnotes should come where a reader expects them.

data.name: A11y_CheckTagsFit
data.value: Does each tag fit its content?

data.name: A11y_CheckTagsFitHow
data.value: Headings are tagged as headings, lists as lists, tables as tables, quotes as quotes; nothing is a heading just to look big.

data.name: A11y_CheckArtifacts
data.value: Are decorations artifacts, and is all real content tagged?

data.name: A11y_CheckArtifactsHow
data.value: Page numbers, running headers and footers, background shapes and lines are artifacts (marked Header or Footer where they are). Nothing a reader needs is an artifact.

data.name: A11y_CheckAltText
data.value: Does every meaningful picture have alternate text that says what it shows?

data.name: A11y_CheckAltTextHow
data.value: Read each figure's alternate text: it says what the picture shows or means, not “image1.png”. Decorative pictures are artifacts instead. Pictures that only mean something together are one figure.

data.name: A11y_CheckCaptions
data.value: Are captions tagged as captions?

data.name: A11y_CheckCaptionsHow
data.value: A figure's or table's caption is a Caption tag inside it, not a separate paragraph.

data.name: A11y_CheckHeadingsHow

data.name: A11y_CheckTables

data.name: A11y_CheckTablesHow
data.value: Header rows and columns are TH cells; layout grids aren't tables; each data cell's header can be told.

data.name: A11y_CheckLists
data.value: Are lists tagged as lists, numbered lists with their numbering?

data.name: A11y_CheckListsHow
data.value: Bulleted and numbered lists are L tags; a numbered list says its numbering (Decimal, UpperRoman, …).

data.name: A11y_CheckLanguage

data.name: A11y_CheckLanguageHow
data.value: The document's language should be the language it is written in; quotes in another language carry their own language on their tags.

data.name: A11y_CheckOcr
data.value: If pages were scanned, is the recognized text right and tagged?

data.name: A11y_CheckOcrHow
data.value: Select text on scanned pages (or listen with Read Aloud): it matches the page and is in the tags.

data.name: A11y_CheckNotesHow
data.value: Footnotes and endnotes are Note tags, references Reference tags, math Formula tags with alternate text.

data.name: A11y_CheckMedia

data.name: A11y_CheckMediaHow

data.name: A11y_CheckFormsHow
data.value: Form-like layouts without fields use PrintField attributes; the fonts' licences allow embedding (most fonts do).
